name: MultiLipi – Translate & Optimize Your Website for Multilingual SEO
author: KUNAL SINGH SHEKHAWAT

sections.description:
MultiLipi enables you to translate and optimize your WordPress website for international growth with powerful AI translation, multilingual SEO automation, and a visual translation editor — all without writing a single line of code.

With support for 120+ languages, MultiLipi empowers marketing teams, eCommerce stores, agencies, and enterprises to expand globally by launching fast, accurate, and SEO-friendly multilingual websites.

Get started at https://multilipi.com

Features

AI-Powered Website Translation
Automatically translate your entire website into 120+ languages using state-of-the-art AI models. MultiLipi delivers fast, context-aware, and high-quality translations, reducing manual effort and ensuring your content resonates with audiences around the world.

Multilingual SEO Optimization
Rank your translated pages on Google and other search engines. MultiLipi generates SEO-friendly URLs, translated meta titles and descriptions, hreflang tags, and localized sitemaps — all automatically configured to comply with multilingual SEO best practices.

Flexible Hosting Structure
Choose how your multilingual content is structured:
-Subdirectories (e.g., yoursite.com/fr/)
-Subdomains (e.g., fr.yoursite.com)
This flexibility allows for improved international targeting and better indexing across regions.

Glossary & Translation Memory
Maintain brand consistency across all translations with a glossary that lets you define key terms, product names, or marketing language. MultiLipi’s translation memory ensures your terminology is reused consistently across your entire site.

Visual Editor & Human Translation Support
Edit your translations directly on your live site using MultiLipi’s in-context visual editor. You can also invite human translators to refine translations and collaborate directly within the dashboard.

Automatic Language Redirection
Deliver a personalized experience by detecting a visitor’s browser language and redirecting them to the correct translated version of your site automatically.

Built-In Analytics Dashboard
Measure the performance of your multilingual content with traffic breakdowns by language, SEO visibility, and engagement — all in one unified dashboard.

Why a Multilingual Website is Necessary

Today, over 70% of internet users prefer to browse in their native language. Despite this, most websites are still built and indexed only in English — missing out on massive global traffic, engagement, and conversion opportunities.

If your website is not multilingual:

  • You risk losing visitors who bounce due to language barriers.
  • Your SEO is limited to a single-language audience.
  • You reduce your trust and conversion potential in international markets.

Adding multilingual support allows your business to:

  • Rank for search queries in 120+ languages
  • Improve global accessibility and UX
  • Expand to new countries without rebuilding your site

MultiLipi gives you everything needed to build and manage a multilingual site at scale — from translation and SEO to analytics and customization.

To learn more about the benefits of multilingual SEO, visit our regularly updated MultiLipi Blog.
To compare how MultiLipi stacks up against tools check out our Comparison Guides.

How It Works

  1. Install the Plugin
    Install and activate the MultiLipi plugin from your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Connect Your Account
    Create a free account at https://multilipi.com, generate your API key, and connect your website with just a few clicks.

  3. Select Languages
    Choose from over 120 supported languages. Translate your entire website or only selected pages and sections, including menus, widgets, WooCommerce products, and more.

  4. Automatic Translation
    Once connected, MultiLipi instantly begins translating your content using powerful AI models. All translated versions are created without any impact on your site’s speed or structure.

  5. Edit Translations
    Use the visual editor to refine your translations directly on your site. Customize slugs, edit meta tags, override default translations, or collaborate with human translators for quality assurance.

  6. SEO Setup & URL Structure
    MultiLipi automatically configures hreflang tags, translated URLs, localized sitemaps, and translated meta information, making your site discoverable in international search engines.

  7. Language Switching & Media Localization
    Customize your language switcher’s design and location. You can also serve different images or videos for different languages if needed.

  8. Track & Improve
    Use the analytics dashboard to see what languages are performing well, identify gaps, and optimize accordingly. Your multilingual website grows smarter as you scale.

Language Support

MultiLipi provides translation support for over 120 languages, with new additions continuously expanding our global coverage. This extensive language support allows you to connect with diverse audiences across the world, including:

  • Major world languages such as English, Spanish, Mandarin, Arabic, French, and Portuguese
  • Regional languages like Hindi, Bengali, Catalan, Tamil, Basque, Gujarati, and more
  • Lesser-supported languages and dialects, ensuring flexibility for businesses targeting niche or underserved markets

You can explore the complete list of supported languages here:
MultiLipi Supported Languages

Third-Party Compatibility

MultiLipi works seamlessly with the most popular WordPress tools and builders, including:

  • WooCommerce – Translate product pages, checkout flows, carts, and more to localize the full shopping experience.
  • Elementor – Effortlessly translate dynamic elements and builder content.
  • Divi, Beaver Builder, and Gutenberg – All fully supported.
  • Yoast SEO – Fully compatible for multilingual SEO configurations.

Your existing themes and plugins continue to function as expected, with no disruptions.

Start Free

Every new user starts with a Free Plan that includes 10,000 AI-translated words and access to all core features.
Upgrade as you grow — paid plans start at $59/month, unlocking higher translation volumes, more languages, and advanced features.
Sign up and get started instantly at: https://multilipi.com

Industry Solutions

Marketing Teams
Translate landing pages, ad campaigns, blog content, and SEO-focused material to reach wider audiences.
Explore marketing solutions

Agencies
Offer multilingual websites to clients across platforms, collaborate with your team inside the dashboard, and manage multiple websites under one account.
Explore agency solutions

Ecommerce Stores
Localize product descriptions, cart experiences, checkout pages, and customer emails to expand into global markets.
Explore ecommerce solutions

Seamless Integrations

MultiLipi integrates with a wide range of modern platforms and technologies:

  • Shopify Integration
  • Wix Integration
  • Webflow Integration

Also compatible with React, Next.js, Django, and custom-built websites.

Affiliate Program

Earn recurring revenue by sharing MultiLipi with your network.
Our Affiliate Program offers 30% lifetime commission on every referral that converts to a paid customer.

Why Choose MultiLipi?

  • Fast Setup – Launch a multilingual site in minutes.
  • No-Code Required – Simple plugin, no technical skills needed.
  • SEO-Ready – Automatically optimize all translations for search engines.
  • Customization – Complete control over language structure, media, and translations.
  • Performance-Friendly – Translations are served via CDN with no slowdown.
  • Enterprise-Ready – Supports WordPress Multisite, API access, and team roles.

If you’re looking for a powerful, easy-to-use solution to go multilingual and reach a truly global audience — MultiLipi is the platform for you.
Visit https://multilipi.com to get started today.

Important Links

  • MultiLipi Service
  • MultiLipi Terms of Service
  • MultiLipi Privacy Policy

By using this plugin, you agree to MultiLipi’s terms and policies.
Please review these documents to understand how your data and content are managed and protected.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to provide translation and language-detection services.

Service: MultiLipi API
Used for: Translating website content automatically.
Data sent: Site URL, selected languages, and content to translate.
Data returned: Translated content.
Terms: https://multilipi.com/terms_and_conditions
Privacy Policy: https://multilipi.com/privacy_policy
sections.faq:
How many languages can I translate my website into?

With MultiLipi, you can translate your website into 120+ languages, including 12 Indian languages such as Hindi, Tamil, Gujarati, and Marathi.

What is a language subdomain or subdirectory?

For multilingual SEO, MultiLipi supports both subdirectories (e.g., www.example.com/hi/) and subdomains (e.g., hi.example.com), ensuring proper indexing and visibility in local search results.

How is MultiLipi optimized for multilingual SEO?

MultiLipi automatically handles SEO best practices like language-specific subdomains/subdirectories, hreflang tag generation, and metadata translation to boost international search visibility.

How accurate is MultiLipi’s machine translation?

Powered by AI neural machine translation, MultiLipi delivers high‑quality translations—plus full manual editing control ensures accuracy and tone.

How can I edit the machine‑translated content?

Use MultiLipi’s Dashboard to edit translations directly. You can make changes yourself or invite team members or professional translators to refine content.

Where are my website translations stored?

All translations are securely stored within the MultiLipi platform. The dashboard provides a clean, organized view of every language version you’ve launched.

How do I know how many translated words I need?

Word count depends on your site’s total content and target languages. Use our Word Count Tool to estimate and get a recommended MultiLipi plan. Visit https://multilipi.com/word-count

Can I use MultiLipi on more than one website?

Yes—on the Pro plan or higher, you can manage multiple sites independently, each with its own translations and user permissions.
